skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand longer dialogues on diverse topics such as culture, society, education, travel, work, environment, past actions, future plans, and opinions about people or things.
Communicate relatively independently and comfortably on a wide range of everyday topics; express and defend personal opinions on simple issues in life.
Read and understand longer texts on diverse topics in life; infer simple conclusions from given information.
Write a short essay of about 150 words to present personal opinions on common social issues, using basic linking devices, a coherent structure, and persuasive arguments.
Apply advanced grammar rules and vocabulary in various contexts.
Expand vocabulary on diverse topics and contexts.
Develop the ability to independently learn and practice language skills.
Complete online assignments to reinforce and practice vocabulary, grammar, and the four skills of listening, speaking, reading, and writing.
